title: Ginger Tofu Stir-Fry
subtitle: with Capsicum and Rice
description: It’s plant power all the way with our super-tasty vegan dishes! Our meat-free, dairy-free, honey-free dishes are amped with plant-based proteins, fresh produce, nuts and seeds. Best of all, they’re for everyone, whether you're vegan, vegetarian or flexitarian.

steps.text: Cook rice: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear. Put in a small saucepan with 250ml (1 cup) water, cover and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Reduce the heat to low and cook for 12 mins or until tender and the water is absorbed. Turn off the heat and stand, covered, for at least 5 mins. Fluff the rice with a fork.

Prep ingredients: Meanwhile, coarsely chop the capsicum. Thinly slice the spring onion. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Peel and finely grate half the ginger. Thinly slice the tofu. Combine 1 tbs soy sauce, 2 tsp sugar and 1½ tbs water in a bowl. Combine 2 tsp cornflour and 3 tsp water in a separate bowl.
Start stir-fry: Heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in a medium deep frypan over high heat (see Kitchen 101). Stir-fry the tofu and capsicum for 2-3 mins until the capsicum is softened.

Finish stir-fry: Add the ginger, garlic and half the spring onion to the tofu mixture and stir-fry for a further 1 min or until fragrant. Add the soy sauce mixture and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium and stir in the cornflour mixture. Cook, stirring, for 1 min or until the liquid boils and thickens. Remove the pan from the heat.
Serve up: Divide the rice and tofu stir-fry among bowls. Scatter over the remaining spring onion and enjoy!

Kitchen 101: Fast and hot is key when stir-frying! Make sure you cook over high heat, stirring constantly so everything is cooked evenly. We've used a deep frypan, but you can use a wok if you have one.
